banks.title: Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) Level I - 2024 (معتمد)
banks.description: Official CFA Level I Curriculum Exam Questions in Equity, Fixed Income & Ethics 2024

questions.subject: القيمة الزمنية
options: قيمة النقود اليوم أعلى من نفس المبلغ مستقبلًا
questions.explanation: النقود المتاحة الآن يمكن استثمارها فتكسب عائدًا، لذا قيمتها الحالية أعلى.

questions.subject: التسعير
questions.explanation: CAPM يربط العائد المتوقع بمعدل خالٍ من المخاطر + علاوة المخاطر المنهجية (بيتا).

questions.subject: المحافظ
questions.explanation: التنويع يقلّل المخاطر الخاصة/غير المنهجية دون التضحية بالعائد المتوقع.

questions.subject: الدخل الثابت
options: قياس حساسية سعر السند لتغيرات العائد
questions.explanation: المدة تقدّر حساسية سعر السند للتغيرات الصغيرة في أسعار الفائدة.

questions.subject: الأخلاقيات
questions.text: ما جوهر معايير الأخلاق في CFA؟
options: النزاهة والكفاءة وخدمة العميل قبل المصلحة الشخصية
questions.explanation: معايير الأخلاق ترتكز على النزاهة والكفاءة والمسؤولية تجاه العملاء والأسواق.

questions.subject: الأساليب الكمية وخصم التدفقات
questions.text: An investor expects to receive $1,000 at the end of each year for the next 5 years. If the annual discount rate is 8%, this cash flow stream represents a(n):
questions.explanation: An ordinary annuity consists of equal cash flows occurring at the end of each consecutive compounding period over a finite time horizon.
questions.source: CFA Institute - CFA Program Level I 2024 (معتمد)

questions.subject: أدوات الدخل الثابت Fixed Income
questions.text: What does 'Macaulay Duration' measure for a fixed-rate coupon-paying bond?
options: The weighted-average time until the bond's promised cash flows are received, expressed in years
The exact percentage change in price for a 100 bps shift in yield
The default risk premium demanded by high-yield investors
The accounting yield to maturity at par value
questions.explanation: Macaulay duration is the weighted-average maturity of a bond's cash flows, where weights are the present value of each cash flow divided by total bond price. Modified duration then measures price sensitivity.
questions.source: CFA Institute - CFA Program Level I 2024 (معتمد)

questions.subject: تقييم الأسهم Equity Valuation
questions.text: According to the Gordon Growth Model (Constant Growth DDM), the intrinsic value of a share of stock (P0) is calculated as:
options: P0 = D1 / (r - g), where D1 is next year's dividend, r is required return, and g is constant dividend growth rate
questions.explanation: The Gordon growth formula is P0 = D1 / (r - g), valid when required return r strictly exceeds the constant sustainable dividend growth rate g.
questions.source: CFA Institute - CFA Program Level I 2024 (معتمد)

questions.subject: إدارة المحافظ الاستثمارية CAPM
questions.text: Under the Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM), the expected return on an individual asset depends solely on its:
options: Systematic (market / non-diversifiable) risk measured by Beta (β)
Total risk measured by variance or standard deviation
questions.explanation: In CAPM, investors are compensated only for bearing systematic risk (Beta) because unsystematic risk can be completely eliminated through efficient portfolio diversification.
questions.source: CFA Institute - CFA Program Level I 2024 (معتمد)

questions.subject: أخلاقيات ومعايير المهنة Ethics
questions.text: Under CFA Institute Standard of Professional Conduct VI(B) - Priority of Transactions, investment transactions for clients and employers must have priority over:
options: Investment transactions in which a Member or Candidate is the beneficial owner
questions.explanation: Standard VI(B) explicitly dictates that personal transactions of CFA members/candidates must never disadvantage client or employer orders, preventing front-running and self-dealing.
questions.source: CFA Institute - Code of Ethics & Standards 2024 (معتمد)
